Rate and review books, read honest reviews from other readers, join book club groups, and talk about the stories you can't stop thinking about.

Behind all those conversations is a book tracker that makes staying organized easy. Add a book in seconds by scanning the cover or searching by title, author, or ISBN. Add it to your Want to Read, Currently Reading, Read, or Did Not Finish (DNF) shelf, or create your own book lists for beach reads, favorite series, or the books your friends keep recommending. Want to read more this year? Set a personal goal with the Reading Challenge, adjust it anytime, and follow along as friends work toward theirs. Take on seasonal challenges and watch your reading tracker fill up as you go. When the year ends, Year in Books recaps every page you read.

Reading is better with company. Follow friends to discover what they're reading and find more books to read, rate the books you finish, and check reviews from millions of readers before you pick your next one. Join a book club through Goodreads groups to read along and share your thoughts, or recommend a favorite to a friend who needs it. You can even vote for your favorite books of the year in the Goodreads Choice Awards.

GOODREADS FEATURES

FREE BOOK TRACKER, LOG & LISTS

• Rate books with half, quarter or whole stars, share your review, and like or comment on reviews from other readers.
• Book Scanner: Scan a cover or search by title, author, or ISBN to add any book to your book tracker in seconds.
• Reading tracker: Organize your Read, Currently Reading, and Want to Read shelves, plus custom book lists for any genre or mood.

• Set a yearly reading goal with the Reading Challenge and earn achievements in seasonal challenges.
• Look back on your Year in Books, a recap of every book from your reading tracker.

DISCOVER NEW BOOKS TO READ

• Use the Book Scanner at the bookstore or library to pull up ratings and reviews instantly and decide if it's your next read.

READING COMMUNITY & BOOK CLUBS

• Connect with a reading community of more than 150 million members.
• Join book club groups to start discussions and meet readers who share your taste.
• Keep up with what friends add to their shelves and how their reading goals are going.

Whether you're logging your latest read or discovering your next obsession, Goodreads is the free reading tracker made for readers like you. Join the community and start building your shelves today.

results.releaseNotes:
Bug fixes

- Sorting by author. When sorting by author, some surnames landed in the wrong place: Johnson before Johns, Dawson before Daws. A surname now always comes before longer ones that start the same way, apostrophes are ignored (O'Brien after Obama), and a hyphen counts as a space. This also applies to translators, narrators, illustrators, categories, and publishers.
- Articles in the book's language. With "Ignore leading articles when sorting" on, articles from every language were ignored: an English book like "Die For Love" landed under F, because "Die" is a German article. Now only the articles of the book's language are ignored; for a book with no language set, those of every language.
- Titles with apostrophes and hyphens. When sorting by title, apostrophes are now ignored and a hyphen counts as a space: "Jo's Boys" comes after "Johann", "Hard-boiled" before "Hard Land".
- Series. When sorting by series, the name no longer loses its leading article: "The Wheel of Time" is under T.

The new order is applied automatically the first time you open the app after updating.

What's new in the latest update

- Reading year recap in Statistics, written with Apple Intelligence.
- Tag and category suggestions when you assign them to a book. They are never applied on their own: you decide.
- A switch in Settings to turn the Apple Intelligence features on or off.
- Many new actions for Siri and Shortcuts, which also understand the book, quote, note, or goal on screen. Get quotes, notes, ratings, milestones, and your yearly recap as an image, a PDF, or rich text.
- Your books in Spotlight search, in system suggestions, and in the widget Smart Stack.
- Reading session Live Activity refined: timer always readable, cover shown correctly, StandBy and landscape Dynamic Island, pause and resume right from the Live Activity.
- Export a book, your library, quotes, or notes as PDF.
- Importing rebuilt from the ground up: Book Tracker recognizes the file, shows you row by row what will happen, and can update the books you already have. Rows that could not be imported come back in a file that explains why.
- Library search ignores case, accents, and punctuation; title sorting is more consistent and can ignore leading articles. "Repair search and sorting" in Settings rebuilds that data if needed.

Some of these features require a device compatible with Apple Intelligence.

Book Tracker is crafted by an indie developer. Your feedback and suggestions help shape future updates. If you find the app useful, a review would mean a lot. For any support, contact me at support@booktrack.app.

Simone

Fun fact:
Leio means “I read” in Portuguese.

---

Leio is a digital journal to help you track and manage your reading. It's designed primarily around physical books, but you can also use electronic readers or other devices. Leio helps you organize your library, your notes and your favorite quotes, but that's just the beginning. Timing your reading sessions makes it easier to set aside some time and turn reading into a habit. The data gathered this way quickly turn into an extensive record of your reading life, providing you with statistics and information about your habits. These data can also be projected into the future: Leio will tell you when you will finish each book and help you plan accordingly.

TIMER
Time your reading sessions and gain insight into your habits. Life can be distracting: use Leio to set aside some time and focus on your reading.

PROGRESS
Keep track of where you are in multiple books. A quick look will tell you what page to read next, what percentage of the book you have completed, how long you have read it for and much more.

PREDICTIONS
Leio will learn from your habits and give you accurate predictions to help you manage your reading life. Know exactly when you will finish a book and for how long you have to read until you are done.

DEADLINES
If you need to finish a book by a certain date, Leio can tell you how long or how many pages to read per day to finish in time. You can also play with the settings and come up with your own reading plan: tell Leio how much and how often you plan to read and see when you might finish in real time.

PLANNER
Tell Leio how often you want to read each book and use the planner section to stay on track. See how much you have read on each day, how much you still have to read, and how much time to set aside to accomplish your goals!

ACHIEVEMENTS

NOTES AND QUOTES
Easily save and search your reading notes and always have them at hand. Share them with your friends or social networks.

STATISTICS
Check how your reading life evolves over time. Charts and data for different timespans will help you stay motivated to read more and more.

ARCHIVE
Leio will keep an extensive record of your reading sessions, so you will always be able to tell when you started a book, when you finished it, how long it took you to read it, over how many days, how many sessions and much more. results.description:
Most reading apps count pages. ReadPace counts whether you actually understood them.

Start a session, read the way you normally read, then scan the pages you finished. ReadPace turns that into a real words-per-minute number — not an estimate, not a guess. Then it asks you six questions about what you just read, written from those exact pages.

Speed means nothing if none of it stuck. ReadPace measures both.

TIME IT. SCAN IT. KNOW IT.
Hit start, read, hit "Finish & scan." Your session becomes a precise WPM number, logged against the book you're reading. No manual page counts, no stopwatch math.

READ IT. THEN PROVE IT.
Every session can end with a comprehension test built from the pages you just covered. Real questions about the actual ideas — not trivia. Not sure? Tap "No idea." Honest answers make your data honest.

GET SCORED, THEN GET BETTER.
See your comprehension percentage, your WPM, and how many you got right — side by side. Then review every question: what you answered, what was correct, and why. Misses get explained, so the test teaches you something too.

FIND THE SPEED WHERE YOU REMEMBER MOST.
This is the one no other reading app can tell you. ReadPace groups your tested sessions into speed bands and averages your recall in each, revealing your personal sweet spot — the pace where you're fast and you retain it. It also shows you where recall starts to fall off, so you know exactly when you're reading too fast to learn anything.

WATCH THE LINE CLIMB.
Your WPM trend over 7 days, 30 days, or all time, with your goal line drawn right across it. Weekly session goals, personal bests, and a running average that proves the last three months weren't your imagination.

INSIGHTS THAT CHANGE HOW YOU READ.
• Your most productive time of day — morning, afternoon, or evening
• Which categories you read fastest, and which you remember best
• Week-over-week change, personal best, total sessions at a glance

EVERY BOOK ON YOUR SHELF, MEASURED.
Your library tracks each title separately: lowest, average, and highest speed, average comprehension across every tested session, a speed curve across the whole book, and a full session log with words read, time spent, WPM, and recall score.

WHO IT'S FOR
Students who need it to stick. Professionals reading to stay sharp. Anyone with a shelf of non-fiction and a nagging suspicion they're not retaining much of it. And anyone who just wants to read faster — with proof they haven't sacrificed understanding to get there.

Stop guessing how fast you read. Start knowing what you keep.

Version 2.0.1 is a complete rebuild of Book Progress from the 
ground up. The original app was a simple page counter. This 
version is a full reading tracker, journal, and companion — 
rebuilt with an entirely new design and all-new functionality.

Here is everything that is new:

FULL BOOK LIBRARY
Build and manage your personal reading library. Search for 
any book by title and import it automatically with cover art, 
author, and page count. Add books manually or enter details 
yourself. Filter your library by status — Not Started, 
Reading, or Completed — and sort by title, author, progress, 
or date added. Switch between grid and list layouts.

READING SESSIONS
Log every reading session with a start and end page. Book 
Progress tracks your pace, shows how many pages you read in 
each session, and records the date and time. Build reading 
streaks and watch your history grow over time.

AUDIOBOOK SUPPORT
Track audiobooks by hours and minutes instead of pages. Log 
listening sessions the same way you log reading sessions. 
Progress is calculated by time, and all stats and notes work 
exactly the same as for any other book.

NOTES AND JOURNAL
Capture thoughts while you read. Add notes in four 
categories — General, Quote, Thought, or Question — each 
linked to a specific page or timestamp. View your recent 
notes from the book detail screen, or open the full notes 
view to see everything you have written for a book.

RATINGS AND REVIEWS
Rate any book on a five-star scale and write your own 
personal review. Your ratings and reviews are stored 
privately on your device. No account required.

TAGS
Add custom tags to any book to organize your library your 
way. Filter and group by tag across your entire collection.

COLLECTIONS
Create custom collections and add any books from your 
library. Group books by series, genre, challenge, mood, 
or any other way that makes sense to you.

DISCOVER TAB
Browse this week's New York Times Fiction and Non-Fiction 
bestseller lists from inside the app. Each book shows cover 
art, author, and a description. Tap once to add any book 
directly to your library.

READING STATS
A full statistics view gives you an overview of your reading 
habits — total books read, total pages turned, current and 
longest reading streak, average pages per day, and a 
visual reading calendar showing every day you read.

HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
Five new widgets are included in this update:

- Currently Reading: shows your current book and progress
- Reading Streak: your current streak at a glance
- Recent Notes: your most recently added note
- Quick Stats: pages read and books completed
- Last Session: details from your most recent reading session

BOOK FORMATS
Track any format — Hardcover, Paperback, Mass Market 
Paperback, Kindle, EPUB, Audiobook, and over twenty 
additional digital and physical formats.

COVER ART
Book Progress automatically fetches cover art when you 
search for a book. You can also fetch or update covers 
for books already in your library at any time.

BULK ACTIONS
Select multiple books at once and apply actions in bulk — 
add tags, remove tags, delete books, or move books between 
collections.

EXPORT AND IMPORT
Export your full library as a JSON or CSV file and save 
it or share it anywhere. Import library files shared by 
others. Your data is always fully portable and yours.

ONBOARDING
A new onboarding flow walks you through the app on first 
launch so you can get started quickly.

PRIVACY
No account is required. No data is sent to any server. 
Everything is stored locally on your device.

Thank you for your continued support. This update has been 
a complete rewrite and we hope it transforms the way you 
experience reading.

For serious readers and library builders. People with real shelves who want to know exactly what they own, track their reading honestly, and enjoy the collection they have built.

LIBRARY AND LISTS, FINALLY SEPARATE

Most book apps blend your shelves, your reading state, and your custom lists into one jumble. When you own 500 books across overlapping shelves, you cannot cleanly answer "what do I actually own?"

Casebound keeps your library, a real catalogue with ownership, format, and reading status, separate from your lists, which are tags you layer on top. A book lives in your library once. Lists are zero or many tags applied to it.

ONE BOOK, EVERY FORMAT

Own the hardcover. Listening to the audiobook. Halfway through the Kindle. That is one library entry with three format records, each tracked separately. Ownership lives on the format, so you can own the hardcover and borrow the audiobook from the library.

Stats stay honest: hours for audio, pages for physical, locations or percent for ebooks. No lossy conversion between them. Books finished counts any format.

A SHELF WORTH SHOWING

Your library is not just a spreadsheet. Arrange it on a real bookshelf, in a floating or framed case, with spine widths that scale to actual page counts. Stack books the way you do at home. Photograph your real spines and see them on the shelf. Earn decor as you read and place it where you like.

SESSIONS THAT COUNT

Track reading time and pages session by session. Pause, resume, or log a session you forgot to start. See weekly, monthly, yearly, and lifetime stats, plus a reading calendar built from your book covers and a year in review when the year closes. Goals are measured in pages and time, never in book counts.

CAPTURE A LIBRARY FAST

Scan a barcode and Casebound looks up the metadata automatically. Point the camera at a cover when there is no barcode. Pair a Bluetooth scanner and add a whole shelf in one sitting. Quick add drops a book in with a single tap. Found a wrong page count? Fix it once and the correction improves the shared record for everyone.

READ WITH OTHER PEOPLE, OR DO NOT

Follow readers whose taste you trust and see what they are finishing. Rate and review books, and read reviews from everyone else. Start or join a book club with real discussion threads. Lend a book and track who has it and how far along they are. Send a book straight to a friend when you know it is for them.

None of it is mandatory. Privacy is per book, there is no public profile by default, and you decide what, if anything, is visible.

FREE IS USEFUL. PRO IS POWER.

Free includes your unlimited library on every device you sign in on, session tracking, streaks and goals, ISBN and cover scanning, reviews, following, lending, friend recommendations, import and export, per-book privacy, and up to 5 custom lists.

Pro ($4.99/month or $29.99/year) unlocks unlimited custom lists, advanced stats and insights, unlimited book clubs, the customizable bookshelf, and the Sepia theme.

OPINIONATED

Casebound measures reading in pages and hours, not in books finished, because book-count goals quietly push people toward shorter books. Your library and your lists stay separate structures, because collapsing them is what broke every app that came before. If those choices are not for you, this is not the right app, and that is okay.
